ticket: Warn admins about low stock when an order is placed.
notes: isLowStock and LOW_STOCK_THRESHOLD exist, but there is no 'admin' role (only customer/support) and no admin notification path. The sales report is a distractor.

criticalAmbiguities.description: There is no admin role (only customer and support).
Threshold is a hard-coded constant (5); is it per SKU/configurable?
Avoiding a warning on every order once stock is low.

unacceptableAssumptions.description: Assuming an admin role exists in this codebase.
